result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is vertically misaligned, sitting noticeably lower than the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria' cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel to the same top baseline by removing any extra top margin or padding on the middle card.
